module "S_CanonicalMask.dss"

product 0 Material "M_CanonicalMask" backend=Graph
  %0 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(1, 2, 3, 4), ParameterName="V", SortPriority=0) : float4 @L7:C1 "V"
  %1 = Swizzle(%0, Mask="xyz") : float3 @L12:C23 "EmissiveColor"
  %2 = Swizzle(%0, Mask="w") : float @L13:C19 "Roughness"
  %3 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(1), ParameterName="S", SortPriority=1) : float @L8:C1 "S"
  %4 = Swizzle(%0, Mask="z") : float @L15:C16 "Normal"
  %5 = Swizzle(%0, Mask="y") : float @L15:C16 "Normal"
  %6 = Swizzle(%0, Mask="x") : float @L15:C16 "Normal"
  %7 = Append(%4, %5) : float2 @L15:C16 "Normal"
  %8 = Append(%7, %6) : float3 @L15:C16 "Normal"
  %9 = MaterialSink(EmissiveColor=%1, Roughness=%2, Opacity=%3, Normal=%8) @L10:C1
  sink %9
